The applicators and Contractor shall ensure they follow these policies. Quality Assurance and Quality Control Methods: The Contractor shall furnish equipment to monitor and ensure evenly spaced, straight, regular, and complete coverage of all areas included in the Contract. The Contractor shall ensure the correct spray rate is applied and that there is quality control in place to ensure the ground coverage is complete and accurate. Both the Contractor and the Government will conduct tests as operations progress to determine uniformity of application. The BLM COR/PI may utilize randomly placed drift cards.
